mean.phrase: the mean is the total of all the values, divided by the number of values

median.phrase: the median is the middle number once they are in order

mode.phrase: the mode is the value that appears most often

range.phrase: the range is the difference between the lowest value and the highest value

average.phrase: mean, median and mode are all types of average — one number that sums up a whole list

total.phrase: turn the mean back into a total first

reverse mean.phrase: find the total first — that is the whole method, every time

frequency.phrase: the table shows how many bags held each count

frequency table.phrase: 20 bags of sweets — the table shows how many bags held each count

grouped.phrase: a grouped table gives an estimate, never an exact value

class.phrase: the table groups them by minutes late

midpoint.phrase: each class stands in for its midpoint — halfway between its two ends

estimate of the mean.phrase: divide by 55 for an estimate of the mean

modal class.phrase: the modal class is the one with the most aircraft

median class.phrase: the first class holds 27, so the 28th falls in the next class

not enough information.phrase: a grouped table cannot say what one loaf cost — not enough information
